_what: Native messaging hosts that follow an extension's presence (computer/follow-presence.mjs). `hosts`: each host Trillion offers to a browser extension, by the name the extension asks for (`name`), the extension's store id (`extension_id`), the program the browser starts (`path`, a program of Trillion's own) and the words the browser shows (`description`). `browsers`: each browser by the app that shows it is installed (`app`), the folder its profiles live in (`profiles`, under which `<profile>/Extensions/<id>` means the extension is there) and the folder it reads host files from (`hosts_in`, under `profiles`). A host file is written only in a browser whose profiles hold its extension, and taken away again, through the install ledger, from a browser that no longer holds it, only while the file is still the one written. With no host listed nothing is written anywhere; a new host or browser is one row.

words.wrote: This computer: {browser} can now reach {host}, because it holds the extension.
words.withdrew: This computer: {browser} no longer holds the extension, so {host} was taken away.
words.changed: This computer: {path} was changed by someone else, so it was left alone.
